title: Sentinel Managed Security Subscription Terms: Renewal, Non-Renewal and Early Termination
content:
## Article 1. Automatic renewal

1.1 A Sentinel Managed Security subscription renews automatically at term end for the tier's renewal term unless a signed non-renewal notice was received no later than the tier's notice period in calendar days before the term end date; a late notice takes effect at the end of the following renewal term.

1.2 The renewal rates are the expiring rates increased by the tier's renewal uplift cap percentage, rounded half up to the cent, unless the tier's current list rates less the applicable discounts are lower, in which case those apply.

1.3 The renewal endpoint commitment equals the endpoint count on the term end date, but never less than the tier's minimum endpoints.

1.4 A renewal may be recorded only while the subscription status is active or suspended. On renewal the subscription takes the renewal term's start and end dates, its length, the renewal rates and the renewal endpoint commitment.

## Article 2. Early termination

2.1 An early termination notice sets the cancellation effective date to the later of the requested date and the notice date plus the tier's notice period in calendar days.

2.2 The early termination fee is the tier's early termination fee percentage of the monthly fees on the minimum commitment for the service months beginning after the effective date through the term end date. It is invoiced when the early termination notice takes effect, in the month of the notice.

## Article 3. Notice status, withdrawal and closing

3.1 When the client's signed notice of non-renewal or early termination takes effect, the subscription moves from active to notice given, with the notice type, the date the notice was received and the cancellation effective date recorded.

3.2 A notice may be withdrawn before its effective date, and the early termination fee is then reversed; the subscription returns to active and the notice details are cleared.

3.3 When the cancellation effective date is reached, the agents are uninstalled and the subscription closes.

## Schedule of illustrations (hypothetical dates, periods and amounts)

**Timeliness of a non-renewal notice.** Term end date 30 June; notice period 60 calendar days. Sixty calendar days before 30 June is 1 May. A signed notice received on 1 May is in time and the subscription does not renew; one received on 2 May is late and takes effect at the end of the following renewal term.

**Renewal rates.** Expiring rates of 20.00 USD per workstation and 40.00 USD per server with an uplift cap of 5 percent give 21.00 USD and 42.00 USD. If the tier's current list rates less the applicable discounts are 22.00 USD and 44.00 USD, they are not lower, and the renewal rates are 21.00 USD and 42.00 USD. If they are 19.00 USD and 38.00 USD, they are lower and apply.

**Renewal commitment.** With minimum endpoints of 25, an endpoint count of 38 on the term end date gives a renewal commitment of 38; a count of 20 gives 25.

**Effective date and fee.** Notice received 1 March with a notice period of 60 calendar days: the notice date plus 60 days is 30 April. A requested date of 31 March gives an effective date of 30 April; a requested date of 31 May gives 31 May. With an effective date of 30 April and a term end date of 31 December, the service months beginning after the effective date through the term end date are May to December, eight months. At a monthly fee on the minimum commitment of 500.00 USD and a fee percentage of 75, the early termination fee is 75 percent of 4000.00 USD, which is 3000.00 USD.

| Subscription status | May a renewal be recorded? |
|---|---|
| Active | Yes |
| Suspended | Yes |
| Ordered, deploying, notice given, closed or cancelled | No |
